feature_override.limit: other startup effects not ruled out

excluded: model/list (no refresh parameter; may fetch catalog)

supervisor.process_group_keeper: unreaped keeper is PGID; child launched with process_group=keeper.pid; TERM ignored by keeper until final SIGKILL
supervisor.group_shutdown: signal owned PGID before reaping keeper; bounded /proc scan checks active members; scratch removed only when group closure confirmed
supervisor.rpc_observation: rpc_methods_sent contains only methods whose local stdin write and flush returned successfully; remote delivery remains unknown

offline_validation.scope: new V3 structural-diagnostic and privacy fixtures only; no prior suites rerun

privacy: No auth contents, account identifiers, session data, raw stdout/stderr, or server error text included.

app_server_transport.notes: Pinned source defines stdio:// default; --stdio is also supported.

protocol_envelope: versionless Codex app-server DTO per pinned rpc.rs; optional jsonrpc accepted only when exact 2.0
protocol_diagnostics: On validation failure only: allowlisted key-presence booleans, unknown-key count without names, JSON type categories, method class, expected-ID match boolean, optional exact-shape SDK semver; no values/raw payload.
